title: Atomic Chat decision model catalog
description: Decision models the app offers for `llama-server --decision` (TurboQuant fork). Each model is a Hugging Face checkpoint folder pinned to one commit; the app downloads every listed file into <data>/decision/models/<id>/<path>, checking bytes and sha256, and hands the folder to the core, whose engine converts it to GGUF once. Every size is the exact byte count from the Hugging Face API.

path.description: Path inside the repository and inside the model folder. A root config.json is refused: the engine would read the folder as a plain transformers model.

id.description: Stable id: the folder name under decision/models and the model id the engine answers with (-a).

revision.description: The full commit the files are pinned to; URLs are https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/<revision>/<path>.

calibrated.description: Whether /v1/systemone probabilities are calibrated for this model.

min_engine.description: The oldest TurboQuant release that runs this model from a checkpoint folder.

gguf_cache_bytes.description: Approximate size of the F16 GGUF the engine converts the folder into.
